question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumān in the Kāśyapa tradition concludes at this point?
premises: The verse marks a textual conclusion.
It names the chapter on the characteristics of the skeleton image.
It gives the chapter’s ordinal position as seventy-fifth.
inference: This is the colophon of the seventy-fifth chapter on the characteristics of the skeleton image.
plain_english: Thus ends the seventy-fifth chapter, on the characteristics of the skeleton image, in the Aṃśumān of Kāśyapa.
